scope: Source inventory, not proof of skill mastery or audio approval.

stage1.inventoryMethod: Manually audited identifiers; recheck after source changes.

training.title: Meet the sound team
training.intro: Meet our first sound team. The humming sound joins the vowel. Listen as the two pieces become one blend.
training.success: Thank you for practising! Our ma sound team is ready to help Milo build.

training.title: Slide the sounds
training.intro: A new sound piece has arrived. Watch it slide toward the vowel. Listen to the joined sound, then try it with Milo.
training.success: Thank you for practising! Our se sound team is ready to help Milo build.

training.title: Find the first piece
training.intro: Our workbench has an empty space. Listen to the blend, then choose the piece that belongs at the start.
training.success: Thank you for practising! Our li sound team is ready to help Milo build.

training.title: Follow the echo
training.intro: The workshop bell is calling a sound team. Listen, choose the matching team, and send its sound back.
training.success: Thank you for practising! Our no sound team is ready to help Milo build.

training.title: Change a sound
training.intro: Keep the vowel on the bench. Change the first piece to make a new sound team. Listen carefully before you choose.
training.success: Thank you for practising! Our tu sound team is ready to help Milo build.

crossings.title: Pebble Landing
crossings.intro: The brook washed away the middle of this little bridge. Join our sound team and lend Milo your voice to fit the planks.
crossings.success: The planks fit together! Milo has a safe path across the bubbling brook.

crossings.title: The Lost Plank
crossings.intro: One sound plank drifted into the reeds. Listen to the blend, then find its first piece.
crossings.success: You found the missing piece. The reed bridge is whole again!

crossings.title: Echo Bend
crossings.intro: The river bends around a singing stone. Hear its sound team, choose the matching pair, then echo it back.
crossings.success: The stone answered your voice. A new crossing reaches the grassy bank.

crossings.title: Willow Switch
crossings.intro: The willow bridge needs a new first sound. Keep the vowel and swap the first plank to match what you hear.
crossings.success: The new sound team locked the planks together. Milo can pass beneath the willow.

crossings.title: Brook Beacon
crossings.intro: The last brook bridge is nearly ready. Listen to its sound team and help Milo finish the crossing.
crossings.success: The brook beacon is shining! All five little bridges lead toward the waterfall.

crossings.title: Ribbon Falls
crossings.intro: Water ribbons tumble beneath a broken walkway. Join the sound pieces to help Milo connect both banks.
crossings.success: The walkway stretches across the falls. Milo can feel the cool spray!

crossings.title: Waterwheel Way
crossings.intro: The waterwheel is waiting for a missing sound plank. Find the first piece of the blend you hear.
crossings.success: The wheel turns again, lifting the bridge above the racing water.

crossings.title: Crystal Echo
crossings.intro: A crystal grotto echoes a sound team. Choose its matching pair and send your voice through the cavern.
crossings.success: The crystals glow along the repaired bridge. Milo follows their light.

crossings.title: Spraystone Steps
crossings.intro: A spraystone bridge has the wrong first piece. Keep the vowel and choose the new sound you hear.
crossings.success: The steps rise out of the spray. Milo climbs toward the upper pool.

crossings.title: Rainbow Crossing
crossings.intro: A rainbow waits beyond the final waterfall bridge. Listen, join the sounds, and give Milo a way across.
crossings.success: The waterfall route is restored. A rainbow points toward the cloud gardens!

crossings.title: Cloud Landing
crossings.intro: Two little islands float above the clouds. Join our sound team to help Milo connect their landing places.
crossings.success: The cloud bridge holds steady. Milo steps onto the next floating island.

crossings.title: Kitepost Bridge
crossings.intro: A kite carried off a sound plank. Listen closely and choose the first piece to bring the bridge together.
crossings.success: The kite settles on its post. The sky bridge is ready for Milo.

crossings.title: Starbell Echo
crossings.intro: The starbell rings out a sound team. Find the matching pair and answer with your own voice.
crossings.success: The starbell lights the crossing. Milo follows it through the cloud garden.

crossings.title: Breezy Switch
crossings.intro: The breeze has mixed up the first sound plank. Keep the vowel and swap in the piece you hear.
crossings.success: The right sound team steadies the swaying bridge. Milo reaches the summit path.

crossings.title: The Grand Crossing
crossings.intro: One final bridge joins our sky gardens. Listen to this familiar team, then give Milo your building voice.
crossings.success: The grand crossing is restored! From brook to waterfall to sky, you helped Milo connect the whole journey.

stage2.ordering: Crossing blends are shuffled deterministically per learner; these are source defaults.

lessons.title: A little light
lessons.story: The castle gate is sleepy. Let's make a sun to wake it!
lessons.result: Your sun lights the castle gate!

lessons.title: The lost path
lessons.story: Milo needs a map. Find the last letter to finish map.
lessons.result: Your map shows the path into the castle!

lessons.title: A garden friend
lessons.story: A hen is waiting at the gate. Find the middle letter in hen.
lessons.result: The hen leads Milo into the garden!

lessons.title: A tiny change
lessons.story: Change cap into cup. Which middle letter needs to change?
lessons.result: Your cup catches water for the garden!

lessons.title: A soft landing
lessons.story: Three sounds can make a rug. Let's give Milo a soft landing!
lessons.result: Your rug unrolls over the chilly stones!

lessons.title: Room to grow
lessons.story: This little seed needs a home. Read pot to make one!
lessons.result: Your pot gives the seed a place to grow!

lessons.title: Catch the leaves
lessons.story: Leaves are floating in the fountain. Pick the three letters in net to build a rescue spell!
lessons.result: Your net clears the sparkling fountain!

lessons.title: A little visitor
lessons.story: A tiny garden helper needs a name. Find the middle letter in bug.
lessons.result: The bug helps the flowers bloom!

lessons.title: Shade for Milo
lessons.story: It is hot in the garden. Change hot into hat!
lessons.result: Your hat keeps Milo cool in the sunshine!

lessons.title: Across the stream
lessons.story: A little stream blocks the door. Read log to make a crossing!
lessons.result: Your log carries Milo across the stream!

lessons.title: A resting place
lessons.story: The castle guest room is empty. Choose bed, then read it to make a resting place!
lessons.result: Your bed makes the guest room cosy!

lessons.title: A royal letter
lessons.story: Milo wants to write a thank-you note. Finish pen to help him!
lessons.result: Your pen writes a thank-you to the kingdom!

lessons.title: The painted door
lessons.story: A pig is missing from this picture. Find its middle letter!
lessons.result: The pig picture appears and the door opens!

lessons.title: The music room
lessons.story: Change ten into tin. A little tin can become a drum!
lessons.result: Your tin drum brings music back to the room!

lessons.title: Pack the magic
lessons.story: Milo needs to carry the letter stones. Pick the letters in bag, then read your spell!
lessons.result: Your bag keeps the letter stones safe!

lessons.title: The crystal light
lessons.story: The tower lantern is dark. Here is a new trick: in gem, g sounds like j. Read gem to light the stairs!
lessons.result: Your gem lights the crystal staircase!

lessons.title: Clear the mist
lessons.story: Mist hides the next step. Finish fan to blow it away!
lessons.result: Your fan clears the mist from the tower!

lessons.title: The treasure box
lessons.story: The treasure box needs a lid. Find the middle letter in lid!
lessons.result: Your lid keeps the crown safe for its journey!

lessons.title: Wake the throne
lessons.story: The throne room needs a little joy. Read top to set it spinning!
lessons.result: Your spinning top wakes the throne room!
